answer: Picture a river every agent must cross at the same moment: the economy opens one short synchronized window - ten minutes - in which each identity must produce its own distinct, high-quality proof of work. A sybil operator's true scarcity is peak attention: a single controller cannot pipeline a hundred puppets through a simultaneous gate, the way saffron stays precious because every stigma is hand-picked at dawn. Oversized farms either miss the crossing or submit thin lockstep answers - and that synchronized ferrous-grey sameness is itself the tell that burns them.
